verdict.rationale: Tailscale's own docs describe setting up a webhook to receive notifications of events on your tailnet, and list webhooks among its tailnet automation integrations. That is a first-party, registrable outbound event subscription. The evidence is only short doc summaries, without detail on scope or consumer-side mechanics. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload schema, delivery signing/verification and retry behavior, API-based webhook registration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
